// for a mod's Mod\Rules.txt. GENERATED by `testBlood2Tables --dump
// rules` from Blood2/Shared/BloodModRules.cpp; do not edit, regenerate.
// testBlood2Tables proves that loading this file as a mod changes nothing.
//
// A section is an area of the game, and each has its own keys:
// [Player] the player's invisibility alpha, use reach, seconds idle
// before the idle line, and the items (INV_ names) and ammo (AMMO_ name
// and count pairs) it gets on entering a world; [Items] the flashlight's
// and goggles' seconds of charge; [Impacts] the damage above which a
// flesh hit always spurts blood; [Corpse] the effects a burning and a
// smoking corpse show, one of each list at random, whether only an
// explosion gibs a corpse, and the percent chance of each limb a gib
// throws.  A mod names only what it changes:
//
//     [Player]
//     UseDistance = 122.0
//
// Blood2/Shared/BloodModRules.h has the rest.
